يلتقطا (form VIII)
# يَلْتَقِطَا (yaltaqiṭā) /jal.ta.qi.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
# يُلْتَقَطَا (yultaqaṭā) /jul.ta.qa.tˤaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَقَطَ (iltaqaṭa)
